paper_title: MIG Automatic Data Selection for Instruction Tuning by Maximizing   Information Gain in Semantic Space
caption: figure
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “Quality Scores” for five different models: IFD, TagNum, DEITA, Base AvgNum, and AvgNum. The horizontal axis represents the model names, listed alphabetically from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Scores,” ranges from 30 to 70 and uses a linear scale with tick marks spaced every 5 units. The value range of the Scores axis is approximately 30 to 68.71, with values including 39.13, 41.90, 42.99, 63.98, 64.71, and 67.64.  The bars are colored in shades of orange and blue, with the tallest bar representing “Base AvgNum” at approximately 67.64, followed by “AvgNum” with a value of 64.71, “DEITA” at 63.98, “TagNum” at 41.90, and “IFD” at 39.13.  No bars are sorted or visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors and heights.
